title: Radio press conference opening in Nairobi
summary: Host introduces the KBS press conference and the three questioners.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Good evening and welcome once again to KBS Radio press conference, which for the next few weeks will be without the familiar voice of Chairman Michael Sumner. Normally in press conference, our personality is connected with the world of politics, government, science, commerce and industry. Tonight is the first time we have had anybody from the world of entertainment. On this occasion, we are delighted to have here in the studio none other than the famous jazz musician Louis Armstrong, affectionately known in households the world over as Satchmo. He'll be questioned by Charles Hayes of East African newspapers, Eric Marsden of the East African standard and Leslie Wink, program organizer of KBS African National Service. Hayes, will you start?
